import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import os


def main():
    # Set environment variables to silence potential warnings
    os.environ["OMP_NUM_THREADS"] = "1"
    os.environ["MKL_NUM_THREADS"] = "1"

    # Ensure submission directory exists
    os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

    # Load data from input directory
    print("Loading data...")
    train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
    test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

    # Check columns availability to align features
    # Based on description, train has 56 cols (likely Id + Features + Cover_Type)
    # Test has 55 cols (likely Id + Features)
    # Sample Submission has Id + Cover_Type

    # Identify feature columns: Exclude 'Id' and 'Cover_Type' from training set
    train_features = [
        col for col in train_df.columns if col != "Id" and col != "Cover_Type"
    ]
    train_target = "Cover_Type"

    # Ensure test df has the same features + Id
    # Remove any column mismatch if necessary, assuming test matches train features
    test_features = [col for col in test_df.columns if col != "Id"]
    assert len(test_features) == len(train_features), "Feature mismatch detected!"

    X_train = train_df[train_features]
    y_train = train_df[train_target]
    X_test = test_df[test_features]

    # Split training data into Train and Validation sets (80/20)
    X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
        X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, stratify=y_train, random_state=42
    )

    # Convert to LightGBM Dataset
    train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_tr, label=y_tr)
    val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=train_data)

    # LightGBM Parameters
    params = {
        "objective": "multiclass",
        "num_class": len(np.unique(y_train)),
        "metric": "auc",
        "boosting_type": "gbdt",
        "verbose": -1,  # Disable verbosity/bar output
        "seed": 42,
    }

    # Train model
    print("Training model...")
    model = lgb.train(
        params,
        train_data,
        num_boost_round=5000,
        valid_sets=[val_data],
        callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=100)],
    )

    # Evaluate on Hold-Out Validation Set
    y_pred_val = model.predict(X_val)
    # Round to integers for probability-like output comparison
    y_pred_val_int = np.round(y_pred_val).astype(int)
    val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, y_pred_val_int)

    print(f"Hold-out Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy}")

    # Evaluate on Test Set
    y_pred_test = model.predict(X_test)
    y_pred_test_int = np.round(y_pred_test).astype(int)

    # Prepare submission file
    submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test_df["Id"], "Cover_Type": y_pred_test_int})

    submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
    print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
    return val_accuracy


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
